observations: Photo 0 shows a TV screen displaying a smart TV interface with app icons like Rakuten TV, DAZN, YouTube, and others. The screen has a watermark 'CHRIST CHINEDU'.
Photo 1 shows a nature scene on the TV screen with vibrant green and red foliage. The screen has a watermark 'CHRIST CHINEDU'.
Photo 2 shows the Philips TV startup screen with the Philips logo and the text 'Television'. The screen also has a watermark 'CHRIST CHINEDU'.
The TV has a slim black bezel and is mounted on a stand. The background is a plain wall with visible electrical outlets and cables.
No physical branding or model number is visible on the TV frame or stand in any photo.
The seller claims it is a 43-inch UHD 4K smart TV with Ambi light, from UK, and branded 'Philip' (likely meant to be 'Philips').

claims.claim: Original Direct UK Philip Android 43inches UHD 4k smart with Ambi light display

The size is claimed as 43 inches but not verifiable from photos. UHD 4K is unverifiable without resolution data. Ambi light is not visible or confirmed in any photo.
